issues.message: 15 % detail blocks: on the bare side, aim for 20 %+.

notes.detail: L1 is a bare stone shell: footing, corbels, two recessed slits; fine for a first level of a wall module but little small detail.
notes.depth: Front has footing, corbels and slits; the inner (back, z2) face is a flat 5-high slab of brick with only cobble patches.
notes.roof: Crenellated parapet on corbels with merlons at even x; reads well. Joins checked against the shared profile (walk top y4 / stand y5, parapet y5, merlons at even x at y6): both open ends (x0, x4) carry the full body, an open 2-wide walk at z1-z2 and merlons at x0 and x4, so pieces join cleanly. Because the module is 5 wide, every join puts two merlons side by side (x4 + next x0); that is common to all stone_wall_* pieces, not a mismatch.
notes.materials: Stone bricks, cobble, mossy cobble: right for a wall.
notes.shape: A plain straight module, as it should be; no shape interest of its own.

visual.summary: Level 1 straight stone wall module: battered cobble footing, 3-deep brick body with two slits, corbelled crenellated parapet and a 2-wide walk at y5.
problems: Inner (back, z2) face is flat brick y0-y4; a plinth course or a few buttress/stair accents would add depth (optional, minor).
